output.review_comment: The implementation correctly fixes all the issues and passes all tests. The mixed case preservation, last word capitalization, and colon handling all work as intended. However, the docstring is now incomplete and should be updated to document the colon handling feature. Specifically, update rule 2 to note that small words are also capitalized when they immediately follow a word ending with a colon (e.g., "A Year" after a colon in "field: a year"). This keeps the specification documentation aligned with the implementation and the agreed-upon editorial spec that the tests encode.
